metadata.label: Open the leased owner fixture with canonical Web Push then Email order
Wait for the routed escalation-order read
Set light appearance for the selected desktop comparison
Stage Email before Web Push without saving

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector("[data-testid=\"escalation-order-root\"]");const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid^=\"escalation-order-channel-\"] h3")].map(n=>n.textContent||"");const text=root?.textContent||"";if(rows.length!==2||!rows[0].includes("Email")||!rows[1].includes("Web Push")||!text.includes("Saved order")||!text.includes("Web Push")||!text.includes("Only overdue critical asks use this order.")||!text.includes("Non-critical asks expire unless a separately governed reversible default applies"))throw new Error(`draft order or critical-only policy disclosure mismatch rows=${JSON.stringify(rows)} text=${text}`);return {rows,savedOrderVisible:true,criticalOnlyDisclosureVisible:true}})()

metadata.label: Verify Email then Web Push is a local draft and saved order plus held eligibility remain disclosed

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.documentElement;for(const key of ['top','right','bottom','left'])root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-'+key,'0px');const insets=Object.fromEntries(['top','right','bottom','left'].map(key=>[key,getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-'+key).trim()]));if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||Object.values(insets).some(value=>value!=='0px'))throw new Error('selected viewport/inset mismatch '+JSON.stringify({width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,insets}));return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},insets}})()

metadata.label: Assert selected 390 by 844 CSS viewport with zero safe-area insets before screenshot
Capture selected light phone state at 390 by 844 CSS pixels
